local_runtime_status: SQLite state, leases and event history are local-only. Evidence checks are deterministic and root-scoped; semantic, UX, identity, production and external-action acceptance remain host-owned.
export_status: Self-contained Skill includes the control-plane contract/runtime/evaluator, bounded self-improvement coordinator, challenge with sensitivity probes, relation checks, capability preflight, generic installer and third-party license. It does not include a scheduler, account credentials or arbitrary tool execution. Host loading and automatic routing require host evidence.
